Title: Custom View
Content: Objective Easily open and save custom view of the 3D window at your convenience. Location Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View Operation Create Rotate the 3D Window as desired. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Left click on the camera icon on the right top corner. The current view is saved and added to the Custom View window. Double click on the added custom view. The 3D Window rotates automatically to reflect the custom view. Open/Save Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Click on the Open or the Save All button. The group of custom views is opened or saved. Delete Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Right-click on the custom view to be deleted. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Delete. The selected custom view is deleted from the Custom View window. Rename Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Right click on the custom view to be deleted. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Rename. Edit the name as the custom view's name field is activated. Title: Zoom In/Out, Rotation
Content: Objective In Marvelous Designer, the mouse wheel and the right button can be used to zoom in, zoom out, and rotate the screen. The Maya and 3Ds Max view control methods are also supported alongside the default view control method and interface can be modified as needed and use differently. Operation Move Hold down the mouse wheel and drag to move the screen. If you are using Mac's Magic Mouse, please hold down the Alt key on the keyboard and click-and-drag the left mouse key. Zoom In/Out Scroll down (zoom in) and up (zoom out) the mouse wheel to zoom in and zoom out the screen. Or, hold down Alt Key on the keyboard and the left button of the mouse simultaneously and drag up (zoom out) or down (zoom in). Note: Zoom in or zoom out using the + (zoom in) and - (zoom out) keys on the keyboard (ver2.4.0.) Rotate Hold down the right button of the mouse and drag to rotate the 3D window.

Title: How to uninstall Marvelous Designer completely
Content: In the process of Live Update or alternately using multiple Marvelous Designer versions, various files, and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software may be damaged, causing the Marvelous Designer software to not operate normally. You can solve this problem by completely uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software and configuration files and then reinstalling it with the latest Marvelous Designer installer. Note Only the files and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software are deleted, and user-created files remain. Before uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software, please back up your files safely. If you have changed the Marvelous Designer install path, find the path and delete it. Windows 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website Under the Marvelous Designer Help menu, select Logout or Deactivate License (software remote logout). Software remote logout from the website &gt 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software Go to Windows Start &gt Settings &gt Apps or Installed Apps &gt Marvelous Designer Software and click Uninstall. If you have installed different product types or multiple versions, uninstall all Marvelous Designer software using the above method. 3 Delete Registry Windows Search &gt Type 'Registry Editor' &gt open as administrator &gt delete the Marvelous Designer registry. Path: ComputerHKEY_CURRENT_USERSOFTWAREMarvelous Designer Network OnlineAuth In the case of individual user version, it is displayed as ~Marvelous Designer Standalone OnlineAuth. If you don't see the Marvelous Designer product name in the Windows Registry, all have been deleted. 4 Delete Marvelous Designer install folder and Assets folder Even after deleting the program, additional downloaded files and some configurations may remain. The default install path is C:Program FilesMarvelous Designer {product name}, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. 5 Delete Marvelous Designer Assets folder from Windows shared folder The default install path is C:UsersPublicDocumentsMarvelous Designer, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. 6 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files Some Marvelous Designer configuration files are stored as hidden files. Go to Windows File Explorer &gt Options &gt Folder Options. Select 'Show hidden files' as shown below and click the 'Apply to Folders' button. Go to C:Users{Windows user name}AppDataLocal, select the CLO folder, and delete it. (Marvelous Designer App data folders are inside of the CLO folder) Mac 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website From the HELP Menu, Log Out or Deactivate License of Marvelous Designer. The application will Quit. Software remote logout from the website &gt 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software Open the MAIN APPLICATION folder on your computer. NOT the Application folder in the User Folder. Find the Marvelous Designer, Right-Click &amp Move to Trash. Only do this if you want to fully uninstall Marvelous Designer. 3 Delete the Marvelous Designer Assets folder To remove all the Marvelous Designer Assets, go into your DOCUMENTS Folder. Delete the Marvelous Designer Folder there. 4 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files Go to your HOME Folder, use Column &amp navigate to the Go Menu. Note the contents on the menu and in the items in the Home folder. Release the menu. Type SHIFT + COMMAND + PERIOD (.) this will activate hidden items. A few things will show up in the Applications folder. Return to the Go Menu and note that LIBRARY is now visible and there are more Items available in the Home folder. Some are dimmed. These are items that are normally hidden. Go into the LIBRARY folder and delete the Marvelous Designer folder under the APPLICATION SUPPORT folder. Next, still in the Library, go into Preferences. Select all the files that begin with COM.Marvelous Designer. (The full name will differ depending on which version of the software you downloaded and installed). Right-Click on one of the selected files and Move to Trash. Empty your Trash. Note If you have deleted only the Marvelous Designer Preferences files, when you start Marvelous Designer again it will be as if it is opening for the first time you will need to input your login information, add your Favorites to the Library and customize your User Settings.

Title: Marvelous Designer Silent Install (No GUI Installation)
Content: You can install Marvelous Designer software without a GUI using the commands described below. This is convenient when installing Marvelous Designer software in an environment with multiple PCs, such as a school or company. Windows 1 Search for Command Prompt (CMD) in Windows Search and run it as administrator. 2 Enter the following into the Command Prompt: MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe /S /USERNAME=&ltWindows Login ID&gt /D=&ltMD install path&gt eg) MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe /S /USERNAME=johndoe /D=C:Program FilesMarvelous Designer 12 Enterprise OnlineAuth Enter the above command in the path where the Marvelous Designer installer is saved. Please rename it to the name of the actual downloaded installation file. (eg:MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe) USERNAME is the user name you see when you log in to Windows. Depending on your Windows login permissions, a User Account Control warning window may appear. If you see a UAC warning, click Yes to continue the installation. macOS 1 Download the attached script file. 2 Run Terminal.app on your Mac. 3 Enter the following into the Terminal: sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/&ltusername&gt/downloads/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Online.app ex1) sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/johndoe/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Online.app ex2) sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/johndoe/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Offline_Annual_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Offline.app Please rename it to the name of the actual downloaded installation file. (example:MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.dmg) USERNAME is the user name you see when you log in to Mac. For macOS, the App name you must enter varies depending on the type of Marvelous Designer product you want to install. Please check the product name carefully before entering it. MarvelousDesigner12Online.app - Enterprise user, OnlineAuth MarvelousDesigner12Offline.app - Enterprise user, OfflineAuth

Title: Corporate Firewall Setup and Allowlisting Marvelous Designer Endpoints
Content: Applicable for: Enterprise users who are using corporate firewall and Allow-listing policies First, make sure you have corporate firewalls and allow-listing policies in place on your network systems. Please contact your company's IT or security team for this allow-listing and firewall setup. Note Marvelous Designer authentication servers only allow HTTPS communication. Therefore, only port 443 is discussed in this article. Until Marvelous Designer 10 version, the verify: peer option inside the Marvelous Designer 10 software was disabled, but from Marvelous Designer 11 version it is enabled and built and distributed. So if your company uses SSL Inspection on your secure network system, please check its detailed settings. If you need to allow-list Marvelous Designer authentication servers for Marvelous Designer logins on a secure network, add the information below to your security solution. If you are experiencing problems downloading in-app assets, please add the domain*.clo-set.com to your allow-list. Non-firewalled customers may not need allow-listing of Marvelous Designer authentication servers. If you need allow-listing and use a corporate firewall IPs to be allow-listed 52.1.24.50 52.20.29.14 Domains to be allow-listed sapi.clo3d.com sapi.clo3d-china.com *.clo-set.com Protocol and port to allow-listed https (443 port) Enable the Firewall option in Marvelous Designer login window (see the screenshot at the bottom) If you need allow-listing but don't use a corporate firewall IPs to be allow-listed 52.1.24.50 52.20.29.14 Domains to be allow-listed api.clo3d.com api.clo3d-china.com *.clo-set.com Protocol and port to allow-listed https (443 port) Disable the Firewall option in Marvelous Designer login window (see below figure) Firewall option at Marvelous Designer login screen Note that the information provided below is only for customers using enterprise firewall solutions, not Windows or macOS firewall features. Check with your company's IT or security team whether you use a firewall.

Title: Proxy Server Setting
Content: * Note Marvelous Designer has removed the Proxy Server option from version 11 and onward, in order to enhance the security for users. If users however, wish to continue using the Proxy Server in their network system, then please refer below. Objective Set the proxy server through environment variables provided by the OS * Note: Only HTTP/HTTPS protocol is supported. Operation 1. Click the start button on the taskbar. 2. Click Edit environment variables. 3. Environment Variables System Variable Click the New... and enter the proxy server information Information When using IP When Using User ID/ Password Variable name PROXY_HTTP (Capital letter) * Note: When connecting to a proxy server using HTTPS, the variable name must be entered as PROXY_HTTPS. Variable value ip:port E.g) 12.34.56.78:80 Id:password@url:port E.g) MD:password123@example.com:8080 * Note: On Mac, you need to enter environment variables in Shell Profile. (Bash Shell: ~/.bash_profile, Z Shell: ~/.zprofile)

Title: 3-Version-Back Update/ Trade-In Policy
Content: 3-Version Back Policy If a version of your perpetual license is 3 versions behind from the latest version at the moment, you are eligible for a 'Version Update' or 'Trade-In'. Please note that the support for the version updates will be discontinued on March 6, 2024 (00:00PDT). Personal License Version Update: Version Update for existing perpetual license will be available up to Marvelous Designer 12. Trade-In: A trade-in purchase option will remain until December 31, 2024. You can trade in your Personal Perpetual License for a 1-year subscription. After that, the perpetual license will be retrieved and cannot be reused. Also within the period of subscription, users will be guaranteed to have full access to the latest version. (The eligibility and the price for Version Upgrade and License Trade-In are the same) Direct Link to Purchase Personal: https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing/per/option/year If you're eligible to purchase this option, a purchase button will be shown on your dashboard.

Content: To update your existing Software License Key after renewing a license, or adding copies, please follow the instruction below. If you're a Windows user, please follow the '1-A' instruction and if you're Linux or Mac OS user, please follow '1-B' instructions. 1-A (Window OS) Step 1. Generate C2V file with the RUS executable file, and submit your C2V file to this page (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com (RUS Download at the bottom) 1-B (Linux or Mac OS) Step 1. Enter ACC Page (LINK) Step 2. Title: Requesting Network Software License activation - First Time installation (Linux OS)
Content: [Software License Key for Network Offline] Generate a C2V for First Time Installation - Linux OS 1. Install a Run-time Environment on your Linux server following by steps below (step1, step2) Step 1. Unzip aksusbd-8.31.1.tar (aksusbd-8.31.1 Download) Step 2. As root, open a terminal window and enter the command: ./dinst Once you are completed with steps above(step1, step2), youre ready to generate a C2V file for the first time installation of an SL key. Step 3. Open a web browser and navigate to (ACC Page) Step 4. Click on the Fingerprint button to create a C2V file. Step 5. Submit your C2V file to this page (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com Step 6. Please refer below to complete a V2C key update. [Applying a V2C on the server] 1. Download the V2C file sent to you from Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select Update/Attach in Options on the left. (Click here to link ACC Page) 3. Click Choose File to find and select the downloaded V2C file. 4. Click Apply File. 5. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. [Double checking an updated License Key] If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1. Open a web browser and navigate to ACC Page 2. Click Features once you see the key info. 3. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed to the correct number.

Title: Requesting Network Offline License Activation For A Separate License - Second or Above Installation (Window OS)
Content: Step 1. Open ACC Page to make sure your server has the HASP Driver installed. If the following screen appears, then the installation is still functioning. If not, install the HASP Driver by following the steps below. a. Download the driver from the link here (HASP Driver Download Link). b. Press 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' and then enter "CMD" in the text field to open the Command Prompt window. (Example) c. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and drop it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path, as shown underlined in the image below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on the keyboard to install. (Example) d. In a web browser, navigate to http://localhost:1947 and check to see if the following screen appears to verify the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. * If an error message pops up, please refer to the troubleshooting manual for Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows part. (Link to the Manual) Step 2. Now you're ready to create a new C2V file. Please download the Multi C2V Generator program and open it. (C2V generator download) Step 3. Click the folder icon, then you can set up the file name and designate the file path in the window that appears. Step 4. Set up the file name with your preference, and click the Save button. Step 5. Click the Generate button in order to generate the file. Step 6. Check the file at designated location to make sure it has been created successfully. Submit your C2V file to this page (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com You will then receive a V2C file from our team to complete the application of the license to your server. Applying a V2C on the server In order to complete a license update with a V2C file, please follow the steps below. 1. Download the V2C file sent to you from the Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select Update/Attach in the Options section on the left. (Click here to link ACC Page) 3. Click Choose File to find and select the downloaded V2C file. 4. Click Apply File. 5. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. [Double checking an updated License Key] If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1. Open a web browser and navigate to the ACC Page 2. Click Features once you see the key info. 3. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed to the correct number of licenses.

Title: Technical guidance for TLS 1.2 update
Content: What is TLS (Transport Layer Security)? Transport Layer Security is a security protocol designed to facilitate data security for communications on the Internet. It protects users' data from various cyber threats and provides a secure connection between users by encrypting data. Does TLS update affect my use of software? Since this update applies to the server, there is no direct impact on users and software. All Operating Systems released after Windows 8 and macOS 10.9 have supported TLS 1.2 by default, so users of the latest OS can seamlessly use the software. Please check if your OS meets the system requirements here. How can I get help? If you encounter any of the following problems during the startup and login, please contact us with a screenshot and detailed description. An error message "Delayed Network Connection" displays when login software. Login window does not appear. Software does not respond after login attempt. Read more When the OS is updated to the latest, various problems caused by differences in TLS versions can be prevented in advance. Find out how to update your OS on the Microsoft or Apple website. This document provides technical guidance for the server and software. For TLS-related problems from your web browser or the specific website you are accessing, please contact the appropriate provider.

Title: Rehost Software License Key to another environment
Content: In order to move your software license key from one environment to another, please follow the steps below. * Please note that this rehost feature is only available if your software license key was generated as a rehostable type. ** If your Software License Key name includes Rehostable on the ACC page, youre eligible to move a software license key to another environment. (ACC Page) Step 1. Collect and Save Information - on a recipient device or PC 1. Open RUS on the destination machine that you want to transfer the SL license to (RUS is attached at the bottom) 2. Click the Transfer License tab on the top menu and click the box next to Save recipient information to. Then name the file according to your preference. 3. Click Collect and Save Information, then the .id file will be saved on the destination machine. Step 2. Generate License Transfer File - on the original device or PC where the software license key is currently installed 1. Copy the .id file that was created from step 1 to the original machine which currently has the SL License installed. 2. Open RUS and click the Transfer License tab. 3. Find the software license key that you want to transfer under the Key Type section and click. 4. Load the .id file to Read the recipient information file 5. Click Generate the license transfer file then name the file according to your preference. 6. Click Generate License Transfer File to create a .h2h file. Step 3. After generating the file, the license will disappear from the source machine. As a result, the software license key is no longer installed on the original environment. Step 4. Apply Update 1. Once the .h2h file is created, copy the .h2h file to the destination machine. 2. Open RUS again and click Apply License File to load the file. 3. Click Apply Update Step 5. You can now check the transferred License on your destination machine on the ACC page (Link to ACC Page)

Title: Allowing remote access for Network offline license
Content: Access ACC page (http://localhost:1947) Allow TCP 1947 port in the network section between the client PC and the license server (firewall, network equipment, etc.) Allow external clients to use licenses on the license server Setting the address of the license server on the client PC In order to allow clients on other networks to find the license server, please change settings as follow Enable Aggressive Search for Remote Licenses option Enter the address of the license server accessible to the Remote License Search Parameters *Please click the Submit button at the bottom to save changes.
